overview_description.description: Jasmine Energy is an AI powered incentive management platform for solar developers. Tracking environmental certificates and credits is complex and time-consuming, leading to missed revenue and administrative headaches. Jasmine automates registration, generation reporting, and credit tracking— starting with RECs and LCFS, Jasmine has helped solar developers, IPPs, TPOs and homeowners generated thousands of dollars in missed revenue, save weeks of manual work, and aggregate small distributed generation to maximize grid value and returns.

about_short_description.short_description: Jasmine is the easiest way to track prices, verify renewable energy generators, and buy & sell Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs/RECs)

product.name: Full Service REC Management
product.description: A service that registers renewable energy generators with regulatory databases, manages meter data, facilitates brokering and transfers of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and handles all related paperwork.

product.name: REC Brokering and Trading Platform
product.description: A platform to verify generator information, compare REC prices, and buy or trade any volume of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

product.name: Generator Registration Service
product.description: A service to register solar and other renewable energy systems with regulatory registries to enable REC issuance.

product.name: Generation Data Management
product.description: Automated management and reading of renewable energy generation data to support REC issuance and compliance.

product.name: Compliance Management
product.description: Management of regulatory compliance related to renewable energy certificate issuance and trading.

product.name: Payment Processing for REC Sales
product.description: A service that handles payments to renewable energy generators for sold Renewable Energy Certificates without requiring paperwork.
